name: schedulebar
description: Capture explicit Codex 'record as task' requests into ScheduleBar.

interface.shortDescription: Record Codex tasks into the local ScheduleBar app
interface.longDescription: ScheduleBar plugin ships lifecycle hooks and an MCP tool that appends explicit record-as-task events to a durable local queue. It does not modify user-level Codex hooks.
defaultPrompt: Record this as a task: file the weekly report on Friday.
